scheme_name: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Medical Help
other_conditions: Family annual income must be greater than ₹2 lakh
Applicant must not be listed in ABMGRSBY (Ayushman Bharat Mahatma Gandhi Rajasthan Swasthya Bima Yojana)
Dependent of an untimely death due to famine, floods, excessive rains, fires, or accidental accidents
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹1.5 lakh in government hospitals or up to ₹90,000 in recognized private hospitals for treatment of serious diseases.
